descriptions.d28d_worm_idle_think_8013aa58: Worm idle thinking: stops a pending sound, returns when this worm is the selected one, keeps aiming at the selected worm while aiming is on, then acts on the squared distance to it: beyond 202500 plays a far clip; beyond 40000 goes idle; beyond 6400 aims if not faced, else plays a busy idle; closer, a faced visible worm occasionally taunts with one of four random clips, otherwise it aims or turns towards the selected worm.
